extracted.stage: Ongoing matrimonial proceedings, through to settlement or trial
extracted.summary: A senior associate at Danvers & Co enquires about £19,000 of funding for his client's representation in ongoing matrimonial proceedings where the disputed assets total around £46,000 and the other side controls the liquid funds.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry on behalf of your client, which we have received and logged. To take this further we would need confirmation of the jurisdiction and the court in which the proceedings are issued, the current stage and any listed hearing dates, and a breakdown of the £46,000 of assets in dispute together with supporting documentation. It would also help to have your client's details, an estimate of costs to settlement or trial, and confirmation of your firm's involvement. We cannot indicate at this stage whether funding is available or on what terms. A member of the team will be in contact once the above information has been reviewed.
